attchmntText: Medicamen Biotech Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Medicamen Biotech Limited filed its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial statements for the half-year ended 30th September 2026. The standalone total assets stood at 34,515.01 lakh rupees as of 30th September 2026, compared to 36,151.83 lakh rupees at 31st March 2026. Standalone equity was 28,460.47 lakh rupees. Standalone total liabilities were 6,054.54 lakh rupees. The standalone cash flow from operating activities was negative 1,082.87 lakh rupees. Cash flow from investing activities was positive 350.69 lakh rupees. Cash flow from financing activities was negative 137.15 lakh rupees. The net decrease in cash and cash equivalents was 87.23 lakh rupees. Cash and bank balances at the end of the period were 3,459.09 lakh rupees. The consolidated total assets were 35,963.69 lakh rupees. Consolidated equity was 28,151.47 lakh rupees. Consolidated cash flow from operating activities was negative 960.72 lakh rupees. The statements were signed on 13th November 2026.

attchmntText: Medicamen Biotech Limited has informed the Exchange about Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018
desc: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018
